name: Tambo del Inka, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Valle Sagrado
positioning: Luxury resort and spa beside the Urubamba River in Peru's Sacred Valley, with its own train station for Machu Picchu
best_for: Travelers heading to Machu Picchu who want to board the train at the hotel
Guests who want a spa resort with Andes and river views in the Sacred Valley

facts.text: The resort is set beside the Urubamba River along the Incan path, inspired by the ancient tambos that gave rest to travelers heading to Machu Picchu.
The train from the hotel's station uses 1920s-style carriages, including a Dining Car and a panoramic Observation Bar Car.
Kallpa Spa offers treatments using traditional Incan ingredients.
The resort has a heated indoor pool.
A number of suites have private balconies and terraces.
Suites have wooden details and luxurious bedding.
All rooms and suites have Le Chemin bath amenities from BYREDO.
Hawa Restaurant serves novo Andean cuisine featuring organic, homegrown ingredients.
Kiri Bar has a gin menu, pisco-based drinks and a terrace with views of the Sacred Valley.
The Luxury Collection Concierge team members are bilingual, certified destination experts who wear the Les Clefs d'Or insignia.
Accommodations face either the Urubamba River or the cordillera and the Chicon glacier.

highlights.text: The hotel has a private train station with service to Machu Picchu.
Kallpa Spa features a thermal circuit, underwater beds, a couples massage room with Jacuzzi and relaxation rooms with starry ceilings.
Rooms look out on the Andes Mountains, the Vilcanota River or the resort gardens.
Interiors weave ancient motifs into contemporary decor, including fireplaces sculpted out of Inca-style stone walls.
The resort has an onsite 2,000 square-meter organic garden producing vegetables, legumes and aromatic herbs.

considerations.text: Alejandro Velasco Astete International Airport in Cusco is about 60 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the high-altitude location may require acclimatization.
